sql.before:
WITH target AS (
 SELECT id, nhl_player_id, canonical_name, verification_status
 FROM public.fhfh_player_identities WHERE nhl_player_id = 8476454 ORDER BY id LIMIT 5
), registry_aliases AS (
 SELECT id, fhfh_player_id, alias, normalized_alias, source, verification_status
 FROM public.fhfh_player_identity_aliases
 WHERE lower(regexp_replace(alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
    OR lower(regexp_replace(normalized_alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
 ORDER BY fhfh_player_id, id LIMIT 40
), lineup_aliases AS (
 SELECT id, alias, normalized_alias, player_id, player_name, team_id, source
 FROM public.lineup_player_name_aliases
 WHERE lower(regexp_replace(alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
    OR lower(regexp_replace(normalized_alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
 ORDER BY player_id, id LIMIT 20
)
SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(t ORDER BY t.id), '[]'::json) FROM target t) AS target,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.fhfh_player_id, a.id), '[]'::json) FROM registry_aliases a) AS registry_aliases,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.player_id, a.id), '[]'::json) FROM lineup_aliases a) AS lineup_aliases;
sql.triggers:
SELECT c.relname AS table_name, t.tgname AS trigger_name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) AS definition,
 p.proname AS function_name
FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('fhfh_player_identity_aliases','lineup_player_name_aliases')
 AND NOT t.tgisinternal
ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname LIMIT 10;
sql.readback:
WITH registry_matches AS (
 SELECT a.id, a.fhfh_player_id, i.nhl_player_id, i.canonical_name, a.alias, a.normalized_alias,
  a.source, a.verification_status, i.verification_status AS identity_verification_status,
  a.source_provenance, a.created_at
 FROM public.fhfh_player_identity_aliases a
 JOIN public.fhfh_player_identities i ON i.id = a.fhfh_player_id
 WHERE lower(regexp_replace(a.alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
    OR lower(regexp_replace(a.normalized_alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 40
), lineup_matches AS (
 SELECT id, alias, normalized_alias, player_id, team_id, source
 FROM public.lineup_player_name_aliases
 WHERE lower(regexp_replace(alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
    OR lower(regexp_replace(normalized_alias, '[.[:space:]]', '', 'g')) = 'rnh'
 ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
)
SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(r ORDER BY r.id), '[]'::json) FROM registry_matches r) AS registry_matches,
 (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.id), '[]'::json) FROM lineup_matches a) AS lineup_matches;
